_readme: Every external endpoint lives here. Items marked verify:true were not reachable from the environment this repo was generated in — confirm on first run.

tigerweb._service_note: {year} is replaced with the ACS year so tract lines match the ACS data. Falls back to fallback_service if that vintage isn't published.

li_parcels.note: NYS ITS Tax Parcel Centroid Points: the statewide assessment roll, one point per property. Used for Nassau/Suffolk walk lists. Only address and building fields are requested — never owner names or mailing addresses. Year built, sq ft and heating fuel are only filled in where the town assessor reports them (parts of Suffolk).

business_licenses.note: NYC DCWP licensed businesses. Only active Premises licenses (a business at a location) are used, never Individual licenses, and only the business category is kept: no names, phone numbers or license numbers.

dac.note: Uses 2010 census tracts. Converted to 2020 tracts via the Census relationship file below. Field names auto-detected when null.
